extension.description: Reviews digline commands that spend model calls, write under .digline/, or expose a way to change the approved baseline. digline is a regression gate for LLM applications, the approved reference lives in your repo.
extension.name: digline command protection

permissions.description: Identifies `digline run`, which executes the suite against the target, spends model and judge calls, and writes a new run under .digline/.
permissions.label: digline suite run
safer_guidance: Confirm which suite and target the run will call and what it will spend before starting it.
Use digline list or digline explain to read runs that already exist instead of producing a new one.

permissions.description: Identifies `digline rejudge`, which calls the judge again on a stored run's recorded answers, spends judge calls, and writes a new run under .digline/.
permissions.label: digline rejudge
safer_guidance: Check the stored run key and the --judge-samples count before judging again, since each sample is a paid call.
Use digline explain to read the existing verdicts before producing new ones.

permissions.description: Identifies `digline promote`, which makes a stored run the approved baseline under .digline/, replacing the reference every later comparison is gated against.
permissions.label: digline baseline promotion
safer_guidance: Run digline compare or digline diff against the current baseline and have a person approve the result before promoting.
Commit the previous baseline first so the promotion can be reviewed and reverted.

permissions.description: Identifies `digline register`, which records a person's disposition about a comparison under .digline/; an agent running it records a decision that belongs to a person.
permissions.label: digline disposition record
safer_guidance: Let the person who reviewed the comparison run digline register and commit the line themselves.
Read the comparison with digline compare or digline explain before any disposition is recorded.

permissions.description: Identifies `digline migrate`, which rewrites stored runs and the baseline under .digline/ to the current schema.
permissions.label: digline store migration
safer_guidance: Run digline migrate --dry-run first and review what it reports it would change.
Commit or back up .digline/ before migrating so the rewrite can be reviewed and reverted.

permissions.description: Identifies `digline view`, which serves a local web UI over the stored runs. The UI exposes a promote action, so the command can change the approved baseline under .digline/ even though it writes nothing by itself.
permissions.label: digline review UI
safer_guidance: Use digline compare, digline diff, or digline explain to read runs without serving a UI that can promote.
Keep the UI bound to 127.0.0.1 and let the person who owns the baseline decide any promotion made from it.
